## About
Frontier Metal Roofing is a Denver roofing contractor focused on metal. We install, repair and maintain metal roofs for homeowners and businesses, from standing seam and corrugated roofs on houses to metal roofing, coatings and ACM panels on retail stores, offices and warehouses.
Colorado weather is hard on a roof. Heavy snow and hailstorms are part of life here, so we build roofs meant to last for decades and cut down on the repairs and replacements that come with older materials like wood shake.
We work with each client on the look they want and what the building needs. We serve Denver and nearby towns like Aurora, Lakewood, Littleton, Centennial and Highlands Ranch.

## Services
- Residential metal roofing: Metal roofs that extend the life and improve the look of Denver homes, including standing seam and corrugated options.
- Standing seam metal roofs: A sleek, modern roof with careful installation and attention to detail, for homes and commercial buildings.
- Corrugated metal roofs: A rustic look with strong weather resistance. We handle everything from tearing off old materials to adjusting the design to your taste.
- Commercial metal roofing: Durable, energy-efficient metal roofs for retail stores, office buildings and industrial facilities.
- Commercial roof coatings: Custom coatings for offices, retail centers, warehouses and industrial buildings, built for Colorado weather.
- ACM panel installation: Custom ACM panel systems for commercial buildings, retail stores, office fronts and warehouses, whether it's a new build or an older facade.
- Metal siding: A durable, low-maintenance alternative to traditional siding for homes and commercial buildings.
- Outdoor metal structures: Custom pergolas, gazebos and other metal structures for your yard or patio.
- Wood shake roof replacement: We take off your old wood shake roof and put on a durable metal roof in its place.
